queries.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?links WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q5; wdt:P27 wd:Q902. ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?links. FILTER(?links >= 3) } ORDER BY DESC(?links) ?item LIMIT 5000

policy: Canonical QIDs deduplicate identity; alias/name collisions with baseline quarantined for resolution. Shared aliases among distinct QIDs are reported, never merged. Eligibility is not playability. Wikidata assertions are not independent primary-source verification.
